userDirection: 不要附加整体左右晃动，靠眼睛和手等本身动作
common:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: replacement production sprite sheet for an animated desktop companion.
Primary request: eliminate ALL artificial left-right sway, body bobbing, rolling, rotating and zooming in this existing animation. The user wants ONLY actual local eye/hand motions.
Input image 1 is the EXACT edit target and identity/style reference. Use its TOP LEFT character as a single MASTER RIG, duplicate that one same drawing into six cells, and edit ONLY the specified eye/hand regions. Do not separately redraw or reinterpret the six whole characters. Preserve the master rig proportions, outfit, face, outlines and watercolor texture.
Canvas: 1536x1024, precise 3 columns by 2 rows, each cell 512x512, frames read row major. Each copy of the MASTER RIG must have exactly the same position within its cell, scale, head/hood contour, torso, legs, shoes and props. Fixed camera, stationary body. Full-body generous margins.
EARLY Shenshen costume remains: plain orange cat-ear hood white inner rim, black parted hair/tuft, orange collared shirt with black tie, black long trousers belt-chain, white fluffy fingerless gloves, orange fluffy-cuff boots, terminal chest badge. No hoodie, shorts, shoulder bag or pompom. Do not alter the identity.
Background truly transparent alpha, no floor or shadows, no checkerboard or white backdrop, no text labels or cell borders.
Critical quality criterion: overlaying the six frames would show the SAME body/hat/boots/prop outline; only eyes and explicitly moving hands differ. Especially no shifting feet or laptop, no side-to-side nodding, no change in head angle.
